selection.groupHashRequirement: sha256 de-identified subject/source-equivalence group; correlated or near-duplicate samples must share the same group_hash

leakageControls: No sample may cross group boundaries.
No label value may influence holdout membership.
No candidate/model output may influence holdout membership.
Once a holdout version is created its membership is immutable.

interpretation.minimumStatisticalAdequacy: not predeclared here; must be approved before promotion review and reported with per-class/group support
